status: exploratory owner-authorized shape constraint; specified before fitting this amendment after previous broad curves looked nearly linear
primary: visible95: every normalized component <=.05 at 10cm and >=.95 at 100cm; positive amplitude in every cell
sensitivity: visible90: .10/.90 endpoint constraints; identical priors otherwise; retain all parameter contrasts
prior_support: width >2cm; width <15.283cm for primary95 or20.480cm for sensitivity90. Midpoint is restricted jointly with width so both transition levels lie inside10–100cm. No clipping or fictitious observations.
latent_hierarchy: position and width-fraction logits each have four independent fixed factorial coefficients Normal(0,1.5) and four participant-coefficient SDs HalfNormal(1); noncentered independent Normal participant scores; Condition/Phase +/- .5, interaction product
nuisance: same Gaussian AT/Baseline likelihood, exact sufficient statistics and positive amplitude HalfNormal(.15s) as directional_sigmoid. Independent delta Normal(0,.2s), Baseline Normal(.6,.4s), participant/type sigma LogNormal(log(.12),.5); exact integrated nuisance likelihood and conditional reconstruction.
cohort: unchanged fixed cleaning; primary40 excluding P011/P033 together; participant × condition × phase pooled Baseline calibration
full_sampling: both variants: four chains 3000tune/3000draws, target .99; one 6000/6000 extension for failed diagnostics only
gate: zero divergences; all-parameter rank Rhat<=1.01; bulk and tail ESS>=400
prediction: primary visible95: five held-distance folds with all AT trials at the held distance omitted across people/cells; independent Baseline retained. Compare the preserved broad positive-amplitude reference predictions on the exact same trials/targets. No CV rerun for visible90.
prediction_sampling: four chains1500tune/1500draws; one 3000tune/6000draw extension only for predictive Rhat>1.01, bulk/tail ESS<400 or divergences
prior_information_check: 5000 simulated prior draws per model, compared with full posterior midpoint/width/sharpness intervals; in-range intervals and minimum sharpness are guaranteed by the prior, not evidence of data identification
estimands: finite-cohort Condition, Phase, interaction and simple contrasts for midpoint cm and normalized sharpness1/(4*width_cm). Logit coefficients are not physical-unit population effects.
figure: explicitly labelled shape-constrained normalized sigmoid at marginal posterior median midpoint/width; display actual unsmoothed RT observations and posterior response uncertainty separately. The normalized model curve is not a transformed observed dataset or a posterior predictive median.
stopping: complete both full fits and all five primary prediction folds regardless of effects; no new p-value-driven tuning
limitations: the visible S, its in-range transition and sharpness floor are imposed, exploratory assumptions; no claim of an observed or validated physiological PPS boundary. Positive amplitude intervals do not establish a response. Preserve all earlier results and measurement/provenance limits. No Pages/manuscript work.
